subject: the PPT v1 interpreter (rtl/ppt_interp.sv, the conformance-certified + WCET-instrumented file, unmodified) synthesized and placed for a second FPGA family on a fully open toolchain

reproduce.toolchain: OSS CAD Suite linux-arm64 20260819: Yosys 0.68+86, nextpnr-0.11.1-7-g4d235150

timing.fail_probe: 50 MHz constraint fails: the ECP5 fabric does not close the Artix-7 clock
timing.bottleneck: the single-cycle atom path (prog word -> atom row -> field register -> 32-bit compare), the same path the 100 MHz pipeline backlog item targets on Artix-7

ecp5.wcet_time_at_fmax: cycle bounds unchanged by construction: universal 408 cycles = 12.9 us at 31.6 MHz; a one-cut policy 8 cycles = 253 ns (vs 8.16 us / 160 ns at the Zynq-7020's closed 50 MHz)

ice40_honest_negative.finding: synth_ice40 succeeds but the async-read table arrays balloon into flip-flops (no distributed RAM in the mapping): 9583 SB_LUT4, ~9900 DFF, 3 SB_RAM40_4K
ice40_honest_negative.consequence: does not fit UP5K (5280 LUTs) or HX8K (7680) at the 48/256 caps; the low-cost iCE40 boards are out without a sync-read memory re-architecture; ECP5 is the open-flow target

claim_rung: toolchain-level portability DEMONSTRATED (synthesizes + closes timing on a second family, fully open flow). NOT claimed: certified on second silicon; that requires the frozen corpus run on a physical ECP5 board.
